name: week
title: This week in the placement office
subtitle: What needs the office, worst first. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Checks not ready, placements without agreement cover or a trained supervisor, unreported incidents, students short of hours or unplaced, late assessments and unsigned hours.
sections.sql: select issue, student, about, on_date, detail from v_attention order by severity, on_date nulls first

sections.title: Starting in the next 30 days
sections.sql: select p.starts_on, p.student, p.programme, p.site, coalesce(p.supervisor, 'NONE') as supervisor, p.status, case when exists (select 1 from v_readiness r where r.code = p.code) then 'NOT READY' else 'ready' end as checks from v_live_placements p where p.starts_on between current_date and current_date + 30 order by p.starts_on, p.student

sections.title: On placement now
sections.sql: select p.student, p.site, p.supervisor, p.ends_on, trim_scale(coalesce((select sum(t.hours) from timesheets t join placements x on x.id = t.placement_id where x.code = p.code), 0)) as hours_logged, p.planned_hours from v_live_placements p where p.stage = 'on placement' order by p.ends_on

name: capacity
title: Places and students
subtitle: Rounds that have not finished: what hosts offered, who is placed and who is still waiting.

sections.title: Rounds
sections.sql: select code, name, starts_on, ends_on, places_offered, placed, waiting from v_capacity order by starts_on

sections.title: Students waiting
sections.sql: select round, starts_on, student, programme, campus from v_unplaced order by starts_on, student

sections.title: Places still open
sections.sql: select round, starts_on, site, organisation, places, filled from v_open_places order by starts_on

sections.title: Hosts
sections.note: Places offered in the last 12 months against the 12 before.
sections.sql: select name as host, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, places_last_12m, places_prior_12m, last_round_on from v_site_trend order by places_last_12m desc

name: compliance
title: Compliance
subtitle: Checks, agreements, insurance, supervision and hours.

sections.title: Placements with a check not ready
sections.sql: select student, site, starts_on, ends_on, requirement_name as check, problem, expires_on from v_readiness order by starts_on

sections.title: Host agreements
sections.sql: select organisation, code as agreement, expires_on, days_left, insurance_expires_on, renewal, live_placements, booked_past_end from v_agreements order by days_left nulls first

sections.title: Supervision gaps
sections.sql: select student, site, starts_on, supervisor, problem from v_supervision_gaps order by starts_on

sections.title: Final-year students short of hours
sections.sql: select student, programme, required_hours, trim_scale(projected_hours) as projected, trim_scale(shortfall) as short from v_hours where year_level >= final_year and shortfall > 0 order by shortfall desc
